== Loops.counting (line 2)
| counting(n)
  instruction
    | sum := 0
  for style=COUNTER
    | for i := 0 to n - 1
    -
      instruction
        | sum := sum + i
  for style=COUNTER
    | for i := 0 to n by 2
    -
      instruction
        | sum := sum + i
  for style=COUNTER
    | for i := n to 1 by -1
    -
      instruction
        | sum := sum - i
  jump
    | return sum

== Loops.enhanced (line 12)
| enhanced(values)
  instruction
    | sum := 0
  for style=TRAVERSAL
    | foreach v in values
    -
      instruction
        | sum := sum + v
  jump
    | return sum

== Loops.whileLoop (line 18)
| whileLoop(n)
  while
    | n > 10?
    -
      instruction
        | n := n / 2
  jump
    | return n

== Loops.endless (line 23)
| endless()
  forever
    -
      call
        | work()

== Loops.work (line 27)
| work()
